description: A User Guide to Climate Change Portals is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Aspen Global Change Institiute. This guide can help people acquire and interpret climate change information that is appropriate for their locality. People with a range of backgrounds (city or county employees, community leaders, and concerned residents) can all find climate information that’s appropriate and relevant to their needs. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Energy and Utilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
